title: Mutation
description: One client write. Atomic per entity: if any field conflicts, nothing in this mutation applies (other mutations in the same push still can).

base_seq.description: The seq the client last saw for this entity. Conflict = a field the server changed since then.

entity_id.description: Entity ULID. For `create`, the client generates it.

labels_add.description: List fields (labels) travel as add/remove deltas so concurrent taggers don't clobber each other.

mutation_id.description: Client-generated ULID; the server's idempotency key. Replaying a mutation_id returns the original result instead of double-applying.
